description: Synthetic unit/passage pairs for the negation check: half real contradictions (the unit negates what its passage states, or the reverse), half traps where a negation is present but does not contradict (idioms, another clause or subject, litotes, double negation, both negated, negation elsewhere in the passage). English and German. No real document text.

cases.unit: The bridge is not open to traffic.
cases.passage: The bridge is open to traffic every day.

cases.unit: The museum does not charge an entry fee.
cases.passage: The museum charges an entry fee of five euros.

cases.unit: The service isn't available on weekends.
cases.passage: The service is available on weekends and holidays.

cases.passage: There is a fee for parking at the station.
